summary: Resolve spec codeLinks against the gildash code index, evaluate boundary, and surface symbols not bound to any card.

context.problem:
Spec cards declare codeLinks pointing at file plus symbol; boundary globs scope where pattern
checks apply. Without delegating symbol facts to a single source (gildash) and a single
resolution path, every consumer (drift, coverage, validate links) re-implements the lookup,
producing inconsistent broken-link results and divergent coverage metrics.

impact.statement: Inconsistent link resolution gives different drift answers across commands, eroding trust in the analyze output.
Without a coverage view of indexed symbols vs. spec codeLinks, important contracts go uncovered with no visibility.

goals.statement: Resolve every codeLink against gildash producing valid, broken, or unresolved classification.
Evaluate boundary globs to scope code-pattern application and detect boundary_inactive drift.
Surface symbols not bound to any card via codeLinks or boundary so unowned design knowledge is visible.

non_goals.statement: Maintaining @spec annotations in source files (delegated to code-binding/annotation-roundtrip).

assumptions.statement: gildash is pinned to a stable version and watch mode is disabled per project policy.
assumptions.verification: Inspect package.json for the pinned gildash version and project_gildash_integration_policy memory.

flow.given: A spec card with three codeLinks all of which point at currently indexed symbols.
flow.then: All three resolve as valid; broken count is zero.

flow.given: A repository with one hundred indexed symbols and specs covering eighty.
flow.then: Twenty symbols are reported as uncovered.

flow.given: A spec card whose boundary glob matches no current files.
flow.then: A boundary_inactive signal is reported alongside link results.

flow.given: A codeLink pointing at a symbol that has been removed from source.
flow.then: The link is reported broken with the offending file plus symbol identified.

flow.given: A private (non-exported) function exists with no codeLink and outside any boundary glob.
flow.then: The private function appears in the uncovered list.

design.overview:
ensureReindexed maintains a fresh gildash snapshot. resolveCardCodeLinks walks codeLinks
and queries gildash for symbol existence, returning a discriminated union (valid / broken).
validateCodeLinks aggregates per-card results plus boundary inactivity. getLinkCoverage and
getUncoveredSymbols compute coverage from the same source.

components.name: ensureReindexed
components.responsibility: Trigger a gildash refresh when needed before any link query.

components.name: resolveCardCodeLinks
components.responsibility: Resolve each codeLink against gildash returning per-link status.

components.name: validateCodeLinks
components.responsibility: Aggregate link statuses plus boundary inactivity into a per-card report.

components.name: getLinkCoverage
components.responsibility: Compute covered vs. total symbol counts for a single card.

components.name: getUncoveredSymbols
components.responsibility: List symbols across the project that no card covers via codeLinks or boundary.

invariants.statement: All link queries use ensureReindexed to read a current gildash snapshot.

Card binding (codeLinks or boundary glob) is the sole inclusion test for coverage classification. Caller-supplied filters (kinds, files, excludePatterns) and project ignorePatterns may further reduce the result, but symbol visibility is never consulted.

policy.subject: Every link or coverage entry point
getUncoveredSymbols and suggestCardScope
policy.predicate: derive inclusion from card binding; symbol visibility MUST NOT influence the result.

external.statement: gildash adopted APIs and deliberately-not-adopted APIs are listed in the project memory and treated as the integration contract.

guarantees.subject: gildash version
guarantees.breaks_if: A new gildash major changes adopted API signatures.

limits.statement: Link resolution is per-snapshot; concurrent source edits during a query may produce stale results.

measure.predicate: Removing a symbol that a spec codeLink points at produces a broken link result on the very next validateCodeLinks call.
measure.method: Integration test that mutates source then queries.

measure.predicate: A private function not bound to any card appears in the uncovered output.
measure.method: Integration test fixture exposing a private symbol with no codeLink and no boundary match; assert it appears in result.uncovered.

cons: Duplicates gildash work; conflicts with single-source-of-truth policy.

alternatives.option: Resolve codeLinks via raw filesystem grep.
cons: Cannot reliably classify symbol kind without an AST

chosen.option: Delegate all symbol facts to gildash through a thin adapter.
